info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Model Contribution Model-spec
info.description: The Banking Contribution Model Creation API enables businesses to establish new contribution models for banking services. This endpoint allows developers to define and submit detailed specifications for contribution models that can be utilized in financial products. It is designed for financial services companies and developers handling model management within banking applications. Typical use cases include creating various contributions for loans, savings, or investment products, facilitating better financial planning and service offerings.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new contribution model by providing the necessary data in the request body. Ensure all required fields are filled out to successfully create the model.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create new contribution models. It requires a JSON object containing the necessary attributes for defining a contribution model, adhering to the specified schema.
